candidates.title: Cache-aware scheduling builds a temporary radix tree for a fixed-length waiting-queue comparison
candidates.snippet: LPM and other cache-aware prefill policies match waiting requests against the KV cache, then use a second temporary tree to identify requests that should wait for a shared prefix. For each cold leader the scheduler allocates a dummy tensor and inserts the truncated key into the second tree. Since [#46022](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46022), keys in that second pass are limited to the defer threshold. A partial match below the threshold never changes the decision. candidates.title: [Bug]: FunctionGemma parser splits at `<end_function_call>` inside an `<escape>`-quoted string, returning a nameless tool call
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  When a FunctionGemma tool call contains the `<end_function_call>` marker inside an `<escape>`-quoted string argument, the parser splits at the inner marker instead of the closing one. The result is a nameless tool call with empty arguments, and the suffix after the split leaks as content. The SAFE control (same text without the inner marker) parses correctly. candidates.title: `/api/chat` truncation re-renders and re-tokenizes the whole remaining history once per dropped message
